page.title: Kɔnɛktɛriw
page.intro: Aw k’aw ka piblisite kɔntiw ɲɔgɔn minɛ. I ka pibilisitew ka mɔgɔw be na My Leads kɔnɔ u yɛrɛ ma, ani wari min be bɔ i ka pibilisitew la, u kelen kelen bɛɛ be sara ani u be sara.

catalog.linkedinDescription: Lead Gen Form be mɔgɔw bilasira ka don N’ ka mɔgɔw la, loon o loon musakaw ani wari min be sara mɔgɔw kelen kelen bɛɛ la, ani mɔgɔw ka ɲɛtaga be ci ka taga LinkedIn kan ( Conversions API ).

banner.connected: LinkedIn be ɲɔgɔn minɛ. Leads be sɔrɔla sisan - nin ɲɛɛ be kurakuraya wagati dɔɔni kɔnɔ.
banner.notConfigured: LinkedIn ma sigi o serveur kan fɔlɔ. Kuntigi dɔ ka ɲi ka LinkedIn appli ka client ID n’a ka gundo fara a kan.
banner.expired: LinkedIn ka ɲɔgɔnye wagati banna, o kama, mɔgɔw tɛ sinsin ɲɔgɔn kan. Aw ka ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ tugun walisa ka taga ɲɛ.
banner.reconnectSoon: LinkedIn b’a ɲini i fɛ i ka don tugun ka kɔn {{date}} ɲɛ. Aw ka ɲɔgɔn minɛ tugun sanni o cɛ walisa ka to ka mɔgɔw lasun u ka taga.

connect.title: LinkedIn ɲɔgɔn sɔrɔ
connect.intro: I ka don ni LinkedIn ka kɔnti ye min b’i ka piblisite mara. Leadrat b’i ka piblisite kɔntiw dɔrɔn lo kalan, Lead Gen Form ka ɲɛminɛbagaw ani piblisite jatebɔw, ani a be yɛlɛmaniw ci i be minw yɛlɛma.
connect.need1: Jɔrɔ min be LinkedIn ka pibilisitew ka kɔnti kan (Viewer wala min ka bon n’o ye).
connect.need2: Jɔrɔ dɔ be sɔrɔ baarakɛyɔrɔ ka ɲɛɛ kan min be ɲɔgɔn minɛ (Kuntigi, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Kuratɛri wala Sɛgɛsɛgɛrikɛla) - LinkedIn b’a ɲini a fɛ a ka ɲɛminɛbagaw tilan.
connect.need3: Telefɔni nimɔrɔ ɲiningali dɔ be sɔrɔ i ka Lead Gen Forms kan - ɲɛminɛbaga minw tɛ ni telefɔni nimɔrɔ ye, u tɛ se ka fara a kan.

connection.noPermission: I be se k’o ɲɛɛ filɛ. Ka paramɛtiriw ɲɔgɔn minɛ ani k’u yɛlɛma, i ka ɲi ka "Paramɛtiriw mara" ka sira sɔrɔ.
connection.fetchTitle: Ka ɲɛminɛbagaw sɔrɔ ka kɛɲɛ ni loonw ye
connection.fetchHint: O be ɲɛminɛbaga kuraw sɛgɛsɛgɛ miniti damanin o miniti damanin ani tile 7 labanw be sɛgɛsɛgɛ tugun loon o loon, o la, foyi tɛ fɔn. I ka baara kɛ n’o ye ka ɲɛsin mɔgɔw ma minw tun be yen sanni i ka ɲɔgɔn minɛ, wala ka wagati dɔ sɛgɛsɛgɛ tugun (fo ka se tile 90 ma wagati kelen na). Leads minw be Leadrat kɔnɔ ka ban, u be yɛlɛma.

accounts.title: Pibilisitew ka kɔnti
accounts.intro: Leads ni statistikiw be sinsin ɲɔgɔn kan ka bɔ piblisite kɔntiw la minw yɛlɛmana yan.
accounts.none: Piblisite kɔnti si ma sɔrɔ o LinkedIn kɔnti koo la. A’ ye kɔnti lɔyɔrɔ sɛgɛsɛgɛ LinkedIn Campaign Manager kɔnɔ , o kɔ, a’ y’a lakuraya.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: A fɔ LinkedIn a ka ɲɛmɔgɔw la juman lo kɛra jigiya tigitigiw ye. Ni LinkedIn ɲɛminɛbaga dɔ sera lɔyɔrɔ dɔ la i ye min sugandi duguman, Leadrat b’o lakali LinkedIn ye , o la i ka kanpaɲi rapɔɔriw be ɲɛminɛbaga ka ɲumanya yira ani LinkedIn be se ka mɔgɔ caaman sɔrɔ i n’a fɔ i ka ɲɛminɛbaga ɲumanw. LinkedIn ka ID ani e-mail ka hash min be sira kelen kan, o dɔrɔn lo be ci.
capi.enabled: Aw ye yɛlɛmaniw ci LinkedIn ma .
capi.type: Rapɔɔri di LinkedIn ma i n’a fɔ .
capi.created: Yɛlɛmani minw kɛra LinkedIn kan ani u be karitiw yira.
